title: MicroTRACE Scenario Catalogue Schema
description: Machine-checkable format for the scenario catalogue (catalogue.v0.yaml)

version.description: Catalogue version identifier; an overlay names itself, e.g. catalogue.pilot-cases.v0

frozen_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the frozen catalogue (required when status=frozen)

coverage_required.description: Whether the catalogue must satisfy complete coverage of findings

scenario.description: A single scenario (attack, lookalike, degraded, nonlink, benign_workload, or admin)

adaptation_note.description: Note on how the scenario was adapted from its source

roles.description: Abstract actors and targets in the scenario

of.description: peer_pod only: the earlier internal_pod role whose service this Pod also belongs to (another replica, same ServiceAccount)

degraded_by.description: How a degraded scenario degrades. source (default): a step loses records (step unobserved); field: a record is rendered with an uncertain or missing field (JOIN_UNCERTAIN, TIME_BASIS_UNKNOWN, observer_loss); volume: the behaviour stays below the rule's threshold. The truth writer warns when a source-degraded UNOBSERVABLE expectation has all its evidence rendered.

window_s.description: Seconds the scenario's steps spread over (default 60). Chains of several hops use more; the run matrix packs runs by total scenario time.

fixture_only.description: If true, this is a lookalike fixture not used for finding coverage

source.description: Source of the scenario (citation or anchor)

anchor.description: Reference to a dataset anchor from dataset-anchors.md

dataset.description: Dataset name (LID-DS, CADETS, BETH, Kube-IDS0, CSIC, K8NTEXT, etc.)

record_ids.description: Specific record IDs (capture_id or record_id) from the dataset

citation.description: Citation for external scenarios (no dataset anchor)

source.description: Citation source (MITRE ATT&CK, CVE, GitHub, incident report, etc.)

step.description: A single step in the scenario

unobserved.description: Sources whose records of this step are lost: the build opens a short SOURCE_IDLE gap window on each such record's source scope, so the records are dropped and the gap is declared in source completeness. World effects still apply.

benign.description: A benign step inside an attack scenario (a chain's decoy): its action is not an attack (GroundTruthAction.is_attack false). Default false.

follows_within_s.description: Place the step within this many seconds after the previous step, instead of at its own random time in the window (a pair close in time).

float.description: Floating group name: the group's steps (a decoy's exec and its action) keep their own order but are inserted at a seeded random position among the scenario's steps, after the steps they reference and the sources of links into them, before the targets of links out of them. Link labels and @step references use step numbers, so they are unchanged.

step.description: Step this step is placed after

after.description: Place the step this gap after the named step: [lo, hi] seconds (uniform) a sum of mtgen.netmodel delays joined by +, each accept_delay (a connect's accept) or reconnect_delay (a fixed-source-port reconnect after the previous accept: the probe's exchange, then an accept delay; G2), with an optional *K for K draws.

repeat.description: Render the step this many times as a burst within the step duration, as one action; "{i}" in a string parameter becomes the copy number (1..repeat). Default 1.

expects.description: List of findings expected from this step

reason.description: Why this finding is expected to be in this state

expected.description: Expected witness status. UNOBSERVABLE: the steps are causally linked but no available source records an instance witness for the link, so a detector should abstain.

gap_of.description: Twin link: place its floating endpoint so the link spans the time between these two steps (x0.75-1.25), the gap of the real link it mirrors.

gap_s.description: Twin link: place its floating endpoint so the link spans a uniform draw from [lo, hi] seconds, or an accept delay (accept_delay, mtgen.netmodel).

contradicted_by.description: Steps whose net.connect is the link's contradiction (a port-reuse nonlink: the socket that reused the tuple before the accept, G2). When every such step loses its connect, truth labels the link UNOBSERVABLE.

ordering.description: false: a truth row only. Step placement ignores it (by default a link's target is placed after its source), so a row added to a built dataset leaves its streams as they are, and two rows between the same steps in both directions (benign continuity in either order) do not form a cycle.

shared_keys.description: Shared key components for the witness (e.g., [FlowId], [lineage_id])

variant.description: A variant of the scenario (different parameterization or rule-shaping)

rulebook_shaped.description: Whether this variant is shaped by the rulebook predicates (attack scenarios must have at least one false)

changes.description: Parameter overrides from the base scenario, applied by the scenario engine: each sets step N's params.key.
